coverage: Python line tracing of the hachoir package source during valid-control replay; lines in parser/audio/mpeg_audio.py are counted separately and parser/audio/id3.py lines must be zero; Atheris import instrumentation for fuzz entry
coverage_limit: Untagged MPEG Layer III only. The harness selects hachoir's MpegAudioFile parser directly (no guessParser dispatch) with validate=True, iterates every frame[] field set to the end of the input, and accepts only streams made entirely of complete Layer III frames with one header tuple: no leading padding, trailing raw bytes, truncated final frame or ID3 tags. It reports MPEG version, layer, sample rate, bitrate, channel mode, channels and the walked frame count; it reads 32-bit frame headers and frame lengths and does not decode audio or side information. Two valid CBR controls do not establish VBR, Xing/Info, free-format, Layer I/II, MPEG-2.5 or tagged-file support.
